notes.message: The 60-day deadline counts from acceptance, and only if the player turned on "Enable Bounty Deadlines" in LunaLib's MagicLib settings (off by default). Otherwise the bounty never expires.
MagicLib puts the reward's items into the battle's loot (the player takes them after the fight).
"No pulsar" → no_pulsar_blackhole (no pulsars and no black holes)
"Inner sector" → location_distance CORE: the inner third of the sector by distance from its centre, preferred
MagicLib can't: "Within N light-years" (MagicLib measures from the sector's centre, not from the giver; use Inner sector or Fringe). The bounty leaves it out.
